defs.def: the organ inside the head that controls movement, thought, memory and feeling 脑

ex.s: We are tempted by sugary treats because our ancestors lived in a calorie-poor world, and our brains developed a response mechanism to these treats that reflected their value — a feeling of reward and satisfaction.
ex.t: 我们会被含糖零食诱惑，因为我们的祖先生活在热量匮乏的世界里，而我们的大脑形成了一种对这些零食的响应机制，反映出它们的价值——一种奖励和满足感。

ex.s: But as we’ve reshaped the world around us, dramatically reducing the cost and effort involved in obtaining calories, we still have the same brains we had thousands of years ago, and this mismatch is at the heart of why so many of us struggle to resist tempting foods that we know we shouldn’t eat.
ex.t: 但当我们重新塑造周围的世界，大幅降低获取卡路里所需的成本和努力时，我们仍然有我们几千年前拥有的同样的大脑，这种不匹配现象正是我们许多人努力抵制诱人的食物的核心，而我们知道我们不应该吃这些食物。

ex.s: Our formative environment as a species was information-poor, so our brains developed a mechanism that prized new information.
ex.t: 作为人类，我们形成期的环境是信息匮乏的，因此我们的大脑形成了一种重视新信息的机制。

ex.s: Our brains can form multiple long-term goals and ambitions.
ex.t: 我们的大脑能够形成多个长期目标和抱负。

ex.s: These social emotions prepare our brains to shape our behaviour according to the norms and values of our family and our community.
ex.t: 这些社会情感使我们的大脑做好准备，根据我们家庭和社区的规范和价值观塑造我们的行为。

ex.s: Brains: Walls Against ChaosD.
ex.t: 大脑：对抗混乱的墙D.

ex.s: Of course, our brains can decline as we grow older for lots of reasons-including other environmental influences or genetic factors.
ex.t: 当然，随着我们年龄增长，大脑可能会因为很多原因而衰退——包括其他环境影响或遗传因素。

ex.s: In some respects, today's powerful computing machines already make our brains look weak.
ex.t: 在某些方面，如今强大的计算机器已经让我们的大脑显得弱小。

ex.s: Make brains more active.
ex.t: 让大脑更活跃。

ex.s: The processes take place to stop our brains becoming loaded with memories.
ex.t: 这些过程的目的是防止我们的大脑被记忆塞满。

ex.s: Tononi’s team measured the size of these connections, or synapses, in the brains of 12 mice.
ex.t: Tononi的团队在12只小鼠的大脑中测量了这些连接或突触的大小。

ex.s: The brain is the centre of the nervous system and controls most of the body’s activities.
ex.t: 大脑是神经系统的中枢，控制着身体大部分的活动。

ex.s: The part of your brain that controls your own movements lights up in response.
ex.t: 控制你自己运动的大脑区域会对此作出反应而被激活。

ex.s: Another issue is that the human brain is highly sensitive to wasted effort.
ex.t: 营员享受的师生比根据年龄组从1:4到1:7不等。

ex.s: As far as your brain is concerned, there are processes that discourage exercise, and processes that encourage it.
ex.t: 就你的大脑而言，有些过程会阻碍锻炼，有些过程则会促进锻炼。

ex.s: Researchers use brain imaging technique to see which brain areas light up when we view paintings that we consider beautiful.
ex.t: 研究人员使用脑成像技术来观察当我们观看我们认为美丽的画作时，哪些大脑区域会被激活。

ex.s: If TMS is applied to a specific part of your brain behind your forehead that is particularly important for decision-making, you suddenly like different kinds of art.
ex.t: 如果TMS被应用到你前额后面的某个特定的大脑部分，对于决策特别重要，那么你突然喜欢不同的艺术。

ex.s: Informed by neuroaesthetics, the next time I create my art I will value the process even more, enjoying the activation of the aesthetic triad in my brain as I admire the vivid images that I have created.
ex.t: 在神经美学启发下，下次我创作艺术时会更重视过程，享受大脑中审美三联体被激活，同时欣赏我创造的生动图像。

ex.s: It's not just corporate jobs, or even paid work that can help keep your brain fit, Then points out.
ex.t: 不只是公司工作，甚至付费工作才能帮助你保持大脑健康，滕指出。

ex.s: They would say to us that playing card games would help my brain.
ex.t: 他们会对我们说玩纸牌游戏有助于我的大脑发育。

ex.s: A comprehensive study of 4, 500 children conducted by the National Institutes of Health in 2018 shows that children who spent more than seven hours a day staring at screens showed evidence of premature thinning of their brain's cortex-the outer layer that processes sensory information.
ex.t: 美国国立卫生研究院2018年对4500名儿童进行的一项综合研究表明，每天盯着屏幕超过七小时的儿童，其大脑皮层的变薄迹象提前出现——大脑皮层是处理感官信息的外层。

ex.s: Challenging work that requires lots of analytical thinking, planning and other managerial skills might help your brain stay sharp as you age, a study published Wednesday in the journal Neurology suggests.
ex.t: 周三发表在《神经学》期刊上的一项研究表明，需要大量分析思考、规划和其他管理技能的富有挑战性的工作，可能有助于你的大脑随着年龄增长保持敏锐。

ex.s: I tried to turn on my brain but the engine just wouldn't start.” I should say my name, of course.
ex.t: “我试图启动我的大脑，可引擎就是打不着火。”当然，我应该说我的名字。

ex.s: This will activate chemicals in your brain to make you feel happier.
ex.t: 这会激活大脑中的化学物质，让你感觉更快乐。

ex.s: It keeps my brain active.” And for elderly people who may be unable to leave their homes without assistance, communication with the outside world is essential, to prevent loneliness and to allow them to call for help in emergencies.
ex.t: 它让我的大脑保持活跃。”对于那些可能在没有帮助的情况下无法离开家的老年人来说，与外界的交流至关重要，这可以防止孤独感，并让他们在紧急情况下能够呼救。

ex.s: Thankfully, the human brain is a complex organ.
ex.t: 值得庆幸的是，人类的大脑是一个复杂的器官。

ex.s: David had a brain disease which prevented him from walking or running like other children, but at school his classmates thought of him as a regular kid.
ex.t: David患有一种脑部疾病，使他无法像其他孩子一样走路或跑步，但在学校里同学们把他当作普通孩子看待。

ex.s: David had a brain disease which prevented him from walking or running like other children, but at school his classmates thought of him as a regular kid.

ex.s: So, your brain’s tendency to ask, “Is it worth it? ” will be hard to quieten.
ex.t: 所以，你大脑倾向于问'值得吗？'的倾向将很难被平息。

ex.s: So how does the brain process motivation?
ex.t: 那么大脑是如何处理动机的呢？

ex.s: Our brains use the system to acquire behavioural patterns regarding safe routes home, efficient food gathering and dangers to avoid.
ex.t: 我们的大脑利用这一系统习得有关安全回家路线、高效觅食以及需要避开的危险的行为模式。

ex.s: The human brain has potential yet to be developed.
ex.t: 人类大脑有待开发的潜力。

ex.s: Neuroaesthetics is a relatively young field of research on what happens in the brain when we make aesthetic assessments.
ex.t: 神经美学是一个相对年轻的研究领域，研究当我们进行审美判断时大脑中发生了什么。

ex.s: The part of the brain related to pleasure is activated in response to something we find beautiful.
ex.t: 与愉悦相关的大脑部分会对我们发现的美的事物作出反应而被激活。

ex.s: The lighting-up of specific brain areas.
ex.t: 特定大脑区域的激活。

ex.s: An advanced brain imaging technology.
ex.t: 一项先进的脑成像技术。

ex.s: Certain part of their brain is activated.
ex.t: 他们大脑的某些部分被激活。

ex.s: They say it can play a big role in calming the brain enough to sleep．
ex.t: 他们说，它在让大脑平静下来、足以入睡方面能发挥很大作用。

ex.s: After a long day at work-sure, you will feel tired, but it can help your brain stay healthy. ”
ex.t: “在漫长的工作一天之后——当然，你会觉得累，但这能帮助你的大脑保持健康。”

ex.s: Then you'll be able to train your brain to select healthy food in real situations.
ex.t: 然后你就能训练你的大脑在真实的场景中选择健康的食物。

ex.s: Lancom trains your brain to learn efficiently, so you absorb more information while in the app and continue leaning outside of it.
ex.t: Lancom训练你的大脑高效学习，因此你在应用内吸收更多信息，并在应用外继续学习。

ex.s: It’s as if the brain is preserving its most important memories.
ex.t: 就好像大脑在保存它最重要的记忆。

ex.s: If Tononi’s theory is right, it would explain why, when we miss a night’s, we find it harder the next day to concentrate and learn new information — our brains may have smaller room for new experiences.
ex.t: 如果托诺尼的理论是对的，就能解释为什么我们少睡一夜后，第二天更难集中注意力和学习新信息——我们的大脑可能为新体验留出的空间更小了。

ex.s: In humans, a greatly enlarged brain boosts self-control, just as it boosts problem-solving skills in the social as well as the physical world.
ex.t: 在人类身上，显著增大的大脑增强了自控力，正如它也增强了我们在社会和物质世界中解决问题的能力。

ex.s: SLEAP uses computer vision (the ability for computers to understand images) and deep learning (an AI approach for training a computer to learn and work like the human brain) to help researchers process images much more quickly.
